lines.en-US: I was too far from what I longed for, and was disappointed every day.

lines.en-US: A teardrop falls from my closed eyes.

lines.en-US: Because even if I was reincarnated a thousand times

lines.en-US: I wouldn’t be able to become this "me" again.
